analysis.reason: 직전 2거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입했으나 MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 하락 추세 지속. ADX 24.1로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 확정은 아직 이름. 5일 연속 변동률은 +4.55%로 상승 마감했으나, 2일 전 -9.87% 급락 이후 반등 강도가 약함.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for the past 2 sessions. RSI entered oversold territory, but MACD histogram worsened, continuing the downtrend. ADX at 24.1 indicates an early stage of trend formation, with direction not yet confirmed. The 5-day cumulative return of +4.55% closed higher, but the rebound strength is weak after the sharp -9.87% drop 2 days prior.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band 165,037 KRW): approaching lower band
[Support & Resistance]

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, buy entry after RSI recovers above 50 and MACD improves
